|game_text='''0 side — Wookiee Slaving Operation'''

''Deploy Kashyyyk system, Slaving Camp Headquarters, and [Virtual Block 8] Special Delivery.'' '''For''' remainder of game, your Trandoshans are slavers. Scum And Villainy may deploy on Slaving Camp Headquarters and may not be canceled while you occupy that site. While you have < 13 cards in hand, your non-unique slavers are immune to Grimtaash. '''Flip''' this card if your slavers control two Kashyyyk battlegrounds and opponent controls no Kashyyyk locations.

'''7 side — Indentured To The Empire'''

'''While''' this side up, whenever you 'enslave' a character, opponent must choose to use 2 Force or lose 1 Force. Once per turn, during battle may add or subtract up to X from your just drawn destiny, where X = the number of Kashyyyk locations you control with a slaver. Once per turn, if you just retrieved Force during battle, may take a slaver, starship, or vehicle retrieved into hand. '''Flip''' this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk locations.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]: the Competitive Balance Team errata of 23 July 2014 to the 7 side (Indentured To The Empire); the 0 side did not change. It is the current text. The first image is the Players Committee card image of the 0 side; no published image shows the new 7-side text, so the second image is a '''CardMaker recreation''' of it ([[:File:VB8-07-Indentured_To_The_Empire-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026, with the art of the release-sheet slip).
* '''Original''' ([[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]): Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>; the 7 side ends “Flip this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk battlegrounds.” The Players Committee card images ([[:File:VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif]], [[:File:VB8-D-indenturedtotheempire-pre.gif]]), the Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> and the PC card data print the same.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): on 23 July 2014 the Competitive Balance Team posted on the rules forum, effective immediately, an errata to the 7 side (the post underlines the title Indentured To The Empire), giving the full text: “{While} this side up, whenever you 'enslave' a character, opponent must choose to use 2 Force or lose 1 Force. Once per turn, during battle may add or subtract up to X from your just drawn destiny, where X = the number of Kashyyyk locations you control with a slaver. Once per turn, if you just retrieved Force during battle, may take a slaver, starship, or vehicle retrieved into hand. {Flip} this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk <s>battlegrounds</s> <u>locations</u>.”<ref name="pcforum-p894811">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 23 July 2014: “The following errata are issued by the Competitive Balance Team, and are effective immediately” ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p894811 forum post])</ref> In the post, “battlegrounds” is struck through and “locations” is underlined (added), so the 7 side now ends “Flip this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk locations.” (any Kashyyyk locations, not only battlegrounds); the rest is the printed text (the post writes the bold first words in braces). The quote header names the sides “Wookiee Slaving Operation” and, underlined, “Indentured to the Empire”. (A plain-text copy of the thread loses the strike-through and reads “battlegrounds locations”; this reading is from the live post.)
